subject: Mythology
title: Why Africa Has a Thousand Mythologies
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Why Africa Has a Thousand Mythologies.

hook.text: Africa does not have one mythology. It has thousands — one for nearly every ethnic group across the continent.

buildup.text: With over 3,000 ethnic groups and 2,000 languages, Africa is the most mythologically diverse place on earth.

discovery.text: Each group created its own gods, creation stories, and moral frameworks based on their landscape and way of life.

twist.text: Colonialism tried to replace these traditions with Christianity and Islam. Many survived by blending with new faiths.

climax.text: Today, scholars are racing to record oral traditions before the last generation of traditional storytellers passes away.

punchline.text: The richest mythology on earth was never written down. It was spoken.

quiz.question: Why does Africa have so many different mythologies?
options: A single original mythology split into regional versions over time
Over 3,000 ethnic groups each created unique gods and stories
Foreign missionaries brought different mythologies to each region
